description.value: Stone Haven Inn B&B is a small, family-owned bed and breakfast located in Valemount, a mountain town on the Yellowhead Highway corridor near Mount Robson Provincial Park — a natural overnight stop for cyclists touring the Yellowhead or headed to or from the Rockies. The property operates primarily through Airbnb and maintains an active, welcoming social media presence. Its rural Sawyer Road location places it slightly outside the village centre.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Facebook page content confirms the business is active (recent February 2024 post), provides a phone number not in OSM ((250) 566-1174), and corroborates the OSM address at 3235 Sawyer Road, Valemount, BC with postal code V0E 2Z0. The page describes a small family-owned B&B and links to an Airbnb listing as the primary booking channel; no cyclist-specific amenities (bike storage, laundry, Wi-Fi confirmation, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the available content, so those fields remain null. The OSM internet_access=wlan tag is not confirmed by website text per the rules.
concerns: OSM name is 'Stone Haven Inn B&B' but Facebook page title is 'Stone Haven Inn Valemount, BC' — minor name discrepancy.
No phone number in OSM; (250) 566-1174 sourced from Facebook page only.
Primary booking channel appears to be Airbnb (airbnb.com/h/stonehaveninnvalemount), not a dedicated website.
OSM community tag places this in 'Cariboo, Chilcotin & Central Interior' but Valemount is in the Columbia-Shuswap Regional District — possible community mis-categorisation.
Postal code V0E 2Z0 found on Facebook but absent from OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible B&B in Valemount with a confirmed address, phone number, and recent social media activity. A legitimate overnight stop for Yellowhead corridor cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Primary booking URL is the Airbnb listing: airbnb.com/h/stonehaveninnvalemount. The Facebook page is the only confirmed web presence and was the source for phone and full address.

wow_evidence: small, family-owned bed and breakfast located in Valemount
